notes: τοῦ διοπετοῦς is split under rule 102: the article takes 'of the image' and the substantival adjective keeps the finite relative clause.
γάρ is left unrepresented, the ASV writing no connective for it.
τὴν Ἐφεσίων πόλιν is read under rule 57: the outer article takes 'the' across the interposed genitive, and the anarthrous genitive keeps its supplied 'of the' as a rule 51 helper.
The supplied 'Ye' before the anarthrous vocative is a rule 7 helper on ἄνδρες, no article standing to take it (rule 89).
